correctness.rationale: For all m,n>=4, the open Lovasz neighborhood complex of K_m square K_n has complete one-skeleton. A nonface triple is exactly a three-edge incidence matching or a three-edge path: counts 6*C(m,3)*C(n,3)+4*C(m,2)*C(n,2). The mod-two edge cochain assigning 1 to cell pairs in distinct rows and columns vanishes on every facial triangle but evaluates to 1 on every missing-triangle boundary. Independent source-free complete 4x4 enumeration reproduced 320 facial, 144 3-path, 96 matching triples, 320/1440/60 four-cell sets containing 0/2/4 missing triples, a connected 240-vertex signed relation graph and 784 sign-inconsistent oriented adjacency occurrences; hence an order-two generator. Every missing triple lies in a 4x4 subgrid, overlapping 4x4 grids share a missing three-corner path, so signed relations unify all classes. The complete graph cycle lattice is integrally generated by triangle boundaries, proving H1=Z/2. W carries the generator iff it has a missing triple; avoiding both patterns means its incidence graph is <=2 disjoint stars, maximal size m+n-2 attained uniquely by full open neighborhoods. Independently enumerated every 11440 seven-cell subset of 4x4 and 125970 eight-cell subset of 4x5 and verified a missing triple. No inference that finite enumeration alone proves all dimensions.
residual_risks: No claim on H2, full fundamental group or full homotopy type for general m,n.

originality.rationale: The exact isolated four-by-four torsion case is acknowledged as earlier published. Matsushita gives general fundamental-group language for neighborhood complexes rather than the rectangular all-parameter integral H1 and sharp inclusion-support classification. The published related all-parameter rook theorem explicitly only determines higher (k>=3) homology and a cofiber; its H1 is not thereby computed. The general H1 generator/support theorem survives as a distinct new extension.
